bridge-type.label: CalDAV Account
bridge-type.description: Connects to a CalDAV server, discovers available calendar collections and manages synchronization.

parameter-group.name: synchronization
parameter-group.label: Synchronization
parameter-group.description: Synchronization frequency and local synchronization range.

parameter.name: url
parameter.label: CalDAV URL
parameter.description: Starting URL for CalDAV discovery. Its meaning depends on the selected discovery mode.

parameter.name: username
parameter.label: Username
parameter.description: Optional username used to authenticate with the CalDAV server.

parameter.name: password
parameter.label: Password
parameter.description: Optional password or application password used to authenticate with the CalDAV server.

parameter.name: authType
parameter.label: Authentication
parameter.description: Authentication method used for the CalDAV server.

parameter.name: requestTimeout
parameter.label: Request Timeout
parameter.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a server response.

parameter.name: verifyCertificate
parameter.label: Verify Certificate
parameter.description: Verifies the TLS certificate of the CalDAV server. Disabling this is not recommended.

parameter.name: discoveryMode
parameter.label: Discovery Mode
parameter.description: Defines what the configured URL represents and which CalDAV discovery steps are performed.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Interval in seconds between synchronization checks.

parameter.name: syncMode
parameter.label: Synchronization Mode
parameter.description: Selects the synchronization method. Automatic mode chooses the best method supported by the server.

parameter.name: maxPastDays
parameter.label: Past Sync Days
parameter.description: Number of past days retained in the local synchronization window.

parameter.name: maxFutureDays
parameter.label: Future Sync Days
parameter.description: Number of future days retained in the local synchronization window.

parameter.name: readOnly
parameter.label: Read Only
parameter.description: Must remain enabled. Calendar modifications are not supported.

thing-type.label: CalDAV Calendar
thing-type.description: Represents one CalDAV calendar collection and provides event instances from the configured time range.

parameter-group.name: range
parameter-group.label: Time Range
parameter-group.description: Defines which event instances are exposed by the calendar thing.

parameter.name: path
parameter.label: Calendar Path
parameter.description: Path or URL of the CalDAV calendar collection.

parameter.name: rangeAnchor
parameter.label: Range Reference
parameter.description: Defines whether offsets are calculated from the start of the current day or from the current time.

parameter.name: rangeStartOffset
parameter.label: Start Offset
parameter.description: Offset at which the output range begins. Negative values select past days.

parameter.name: rangeEndOffset
parameter.label: End Offset
parameter.description: Offset defining the last included day of the output range.

parameter.name: maxEvents
parameter.label: Maximum Events
parameter.description: Maximum number of event instances exposed for the configured time range.

parameter.name: includeCancelled
parameter.label: Include Cancelled Events
parameter.description: Includes cancelled events in the output.
